title: Sales Advisor
description:
Where: BT Customer Contact Centre, Gosforth Park Way, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE12 8 ET

Full time: Permanent

Salary: £26,116 rising to £26.738 after 8 months of being here, plus incentives and bonuses

Start date: January 2027

Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday 08:30-21:00 08:45-21:00 OFF OFF OFF 08:00-20:00 08:00-20:00 OFF OFF 08:45-21:00 08:45-21:00 08:45-21:00 OFF OFF

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

We are looking for an ambitious SDR looking to take on a new challenge and more responsibility within a newly formed revenue team. The Sales Development Representative is responsible for creating qualified sales opportunities through disciplined outbound prospecting, consistent call activity, high-quality engagement with target accounts, proposal support, quote production and booking demos for the training team to deliver.

For the first six months, the role will focus on working through targeted call lists, testing outreach messaging, enriching the CRM, improving data quality and helping shape a repeatable outbound strategy alongside the Head of Revenue and Marketing team.

The longer-term purpose of the role is to help modernise and mature the revenue function by establishing outbound best practice, improving systems and processes, and becoming capable of supporting the recruitment, onboarding and day-to-day management of an additional SDR hire.

Key responsibilities:

Outbound Prospecting
- Work through targeted outbound call lists with pace, discipline and a clear focus on generating qualified conversations.
- Consistently meet agreed daily, weekly and monthly call targets while maintaining quality and professionalism.
- Research target accounts and contacts to personalise outreach and improve connect-to-conversation conversion.
- Qualify prospects using agreed criteria, book high-quality next steps for the appropriate sales owner, and arrange product or training demos for the training team to deliver where appropriate.
- Capture objections, customer language and market feedback to help refine messaging, segmentation and campaign performance.
- Support proposal building and accurate quote production by gathering prospect requirements, confirming relevant details and ensuring information is handed over clearly.

Revenue Systems & Process
- Use the CRM consistently and accurately to record calls, outcomes, next steps, demo bookings, quote status, proposal activity, prospect status and campaign learnings.
- Help identify gaps in outbound data, reporting, sequences and handover processes, escalating recommendations to the Head of Revenue.
- Support the development of repeatable outbound playbooks, call structures, messaging frameworks and lead qualification standards.
- Work closely with Marketing to provide feedback on campaign quality, lead sources, customer segments and messaging performance.
- Contribute to the modernisation of the revenue function by adopting new tools, improving data discipline and helping embed better ways of working.
- Coordinate effectively with the training team to ensure booked demos are well briefed, relevant to prospect needs and supported by accurate commercial information.

Required skills and experience:
- 2-3 years' experience in a B2 B sales development, outbound sales, lead generation or similar revenue role.
- Experience of SaaS within a healthcare setting would be advantageous.

title: Telesales / Business Developer
description:
Join the UK's No 1 Trade Kitchen Supplier
Join Howdens as a Business Developer and play a key role in growing your local depot. We're looking for someone who enjoys speaking to people face to face and on the phone, building relationships and driving business. You'll introduce new trade customers to Howdens, stay close to your existing accounts, and spot opportunities to grow spend by understanding what your customers need and what they're working on.
Working as part of a busy, depot team, you'll support sales activity by generating leads, arranging appointments and keeping the pipeline moving. You'll work closely with our Kitchen Sales Designers and our Territory Sales Representatives, helping convert conversations into opportunities and opportunities into sales. If you're confident on the phone, enjoy building rapport, and are motivated by targets and results, you'll fit right in.
What we can offer you:
- Competitive salary, brilliant bonuses and outstanding depot incentives
- Excellent pension plan with up to 12% company contribution
- Up to 32 days annual leave, including bank holidays.
- Holiday entitlement rises with service
- Generous staff discount on Howdens products
- Buy-as-you-earn share scheme
- 40 hour working week
- No evening, Sunday or Bank Holiday working
- Virtual GP access and wellbeing support for you and your family
- A strong team culture that genuinely sets us apart

What we're looking for:
- A confident communicator who is comfortable speaking to customers on the phone and face to face
- Someone who enjoys building relationships and turning conversations into opportunities
- Commercially minded, with a focus on driving sales and adding value
- Self-motivated, positive and proactive
- Organised and reliable, able to manage customer activity and keep track of pipelines
- Comfortable working to call targets and activity levels
- Experience in telesales, account management or a customer focused role is helpful

What you'll be doing:
- Calling existing trade customers to build long term relationships and grow future business
- Using customer data to spot inactivity and bring accounts back on track
- Managing a targeted customer list and achieving daily call activity levels
- Keeping up to date with customer projects to identify opportunities to add value and drive repeat business
- Arranging surveys and appointments for our Kitchen Sales Designers
- Promoting products, offers and events to keep customers engaged
- Supporting administration, including invoicing and general depot tasks
- Working closely with the wider team to help the depot hit its targets and deliver great service

What it's like to work here:
- We take pride in getting things right first time for our customers
- Everyone pulls their weight and supports each other as one team
- It's a busy depot, so we keep things simple, work fast and get the job done
- We all play a part in the depot's success and share in the team bonus
- We build trust by doing what we say we will, every day

How to apply:
If Howdens sounds like the kind of place where you can build and develop your career as a Business Developer, then we are keen to hear from you.

Howdens Joinery is a highly successful FTSE 100 business, with more than 900 depots nationwide and more than 11,000 staff. Last year our sales reached circa 2.3bn, and we continue to experience significant growth and success. Despite our scale, Howdens remains a local business with traditional values.
There is a strong entrepreneurial ethos and the opportunity to develop within a fast-paced and commercial environment. That, along with a competitive salary, development opportunities, and exciting rewards, are among the reasons why our people enjoy working for Howdens - and why we have been named one of the 10 Best Big Companies to Work For.

title: Client Adviser
description:
If you are doing solid commercial insurance work in Newcastle but feel your current role has become too narrow, too transactional or too predictable, this could be worth a look. This Client Adviser position would suit an Account Handler who enjoys looking after established client relationships, wants more variety in the work and is keen to develop further into international business without stepping away from the core discipline of good commercial insurance handling.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in getting the detail right, keeps clients informed properly and understands that good service in commercial insurance is not about noise or theatre. It is about judgement, reliability and being trusted by clients and colleagues alike.

The opportunity

The position sits within a commercial team handling a broad range of business, including clients with international exposures. You will be working closely with Account Executives, insurers and clients, supporting the placement and day-to-day management of commercial insurance programmes across multiple classes. The mix of work should appeal to an Account Handler or Client Adviser who wants to stay close to clients while broadening their exposure to more complex and internationally minded risks.

For the right person, this offers a sensible next move. You do not need to be coming from a fully international insurance background already, but you do need a strong grounding in commercial insurance and the confidence to handle client queries, renewals, adjustments and market interaction professionally.

What the role involves

You will be responsible for supporting a portfolio of commercial clients and helping to make sure their insurance arrangements are administered accurately and managed properly throughout the policy cycle. You will be dealing with existing business, renewals, mid-term adjustments, insurer negotiations and client servicing, while working as part of a team that values technical quality and consistency.

Responsibilities
- Support the servicing of commercial insurance clients across a range of sectors and risk profiles
- Handle renewals, mid-term adjustments, new business support and general account administration
- Liaise with insurers to obtain terms, negotiate where appropriate and secure suitable cover
- Prepare client documentation and ensure records, systems and correspondence are accurate and up to date
- Work with Account Executives and senior colleagues to deliver a high standard of client service
- Assist with business that includes overseas or international elements, depending on experience
- Build a sound understanding of client needs and contribute to long-term account retention

Who this role could suit
- An Account Handler or Client Adviser with commercial insurance experience
- Someone working in a broking environment who wants broader, more interesting client exposure
- A technically capable insurance professional who values accuracy, relationships and steady progression
- An individual based in or around Newcastle who wants a role with genuine long-term potential
- A commercial insurance professional interested in international work, global programmes or cross-border client activity

Salary and benefits
- Salary is negotiable depending on experience
- Strong overall benefits package
- Supportive team environment
- Real scope for progression
- Exposure to quality commercial and international insurance work
- Newcastle-based opportunity with an established market presence

The next step

If you are an Account Handler or Client Adviser and would like a more detailed conversation about where this role could take you, I would be happy to talk you through it in confidence. There is no pressure and no hard sell, just a straightforward discussion about the role, the team and whether it feels like the right move for you.

description:

We are Zenith are working with our client who are recruiting for multiple Customer Service Vacancies due to start ASAP.

You ll support customers when something goes wrong at home from broken boilers to burst pipes helping them get fast, reliable assistance when they need it most. We re looking for self-motivated people who learn quickly, take ownership and are confident working in a busy call-centre environment.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Take inbound and make outbound calls, with no cold calling.
- Log claims accurately and arrange engineer visits.
- Keep customers updated and help ensure repairs progress efficiently.
- Recognise when customers need additional support and respond with care.

The People & Experience we are looking for

- A positive, helpful attitude and a willingness to take ownership.
- Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
- Confidence using computers and managing several tasks at once.
- Reliability, flexibility and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

- Full-time role with a four-day working week.
- Shifts follow a 12-week rotating pattern across all seven days, including Saturdays and Sundays. This is not a Monday-to-Friday role.
- During summer, you ll work a combination of eight-hour and ten-hour shifts.
- During winter, you ll work ten-hour shifts only.
- Working hours are averaged over the year, and you ll be paid for 37.5 hours each week.
- Shift times vary between 6:00am and 10:00pm.
- Rotas are provided in advance.
- A free taxi service is available for 6:00am starts and 10:00pm finishes.

Your first week will consist of essential training, Monday to Friday, from 9:30am to 4:30pm. The training dates and hours are fixed and non-negotiable. We cannot accommodate holidays, routine appointments or other planned personal commitments during these sessions. Please apply only if you can commit to the full training programme. Failure to attend or complete mandatory training may result in your employment being terminated, subject to applicable statutory rights and any reasonable adjustments required by law. You ll need to engage fully with the learning, ask questions and demonstrate that you can pick up new information and processes quickly.
